user_feedback: P and S labels repeated three ways on inline valve base plot.
Need to know whether repeated labels were assembly build error or plotter error.
root_cause: The assembly correctly contained one GD-Con for each physical connector, but the plotter labelled the same connector from active structure slots and from both pipe-side and structure-side associations.
implemented_rules: Assembly plots with explicit GD-Con associations must show one connection label per physical GD-Con.
When a GD-Con has both pipe-side and structure-side associations, the structure-side association is the authoritative review label.
EA connector fallback symbols are suppressed when assembly association labels are present.
validation: Added regression test for one P and one S label for two explicit GD-Con connectors.
